title: ulei.toml
description: C9 (draft): every section and key of `ulei.toml`, the one config file of the daemons (ADR-0040). A document is the file parsed as TOML. Every section is closed; every key is one of five kinds: `string`, `integer`, `boolean`, `["integer", "string"]` for a value the subset can only write as text, and `["boolean", "integer", "string"]` for a switch. A `string` key may list its values in `enum`; the binary reading it checks the value. An item section maps a name to its keys; a section with keys beside its items takes no item of a key's name. There is no key for a secret value: secrets stay in the files the `*_file` keys name. No key is required by the schema; each binary requires the keys it reads.

root.description: The inbox root directory holding `events.sqlite3` and `producer.key`.

socket.description: The C1 socket, at most 107 bytes.

deliver.description: Whether `serve` runs the delivery loop to `engine.c6_socket`; default false.

owner_session.description: The session key of the owner's session.

default_route.description: The route alias the turns of `serve` run on.

terminal_output.description: Directory of the full output of cut `terminal` results.

concurrent_tool_timeout.description: Seconds of one parallel segment of tool calls.

max_steps.description: Steps of one turn: a count or an unlimited spelling.

prompt_cache.description: The C4G cache mode of every turn, compaction and `no-ask-guard` classifier request; `off` sends none; default `auto_1h`.

hardline_malformed_mode.description: What the hardline floor does with a `terminal` command whose grep pattern operands do not parse: `warn` writes a warning line and matches the patterns on more variants, `block` refuses it; default `warn`.

service_unit.description: The systemd unit running the engine.

memory_char_limit.description: Char limit of the MEMORY store.

user_char_limit.description: Char limit of the USER store.

disabled_skills.description: Comma-separated names of the skills left out.

skills_index.description: Switch of the skills index in the system prompt; default off.

task_board_file.description: The file telling how to reach the task board, which the task-delegation meta-skill of the core names; unset, the meta-skill says that no task board is configured.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; the host's local time when unset.

web_helper.description: The `ulei-web` helper binary; the web tools need it.

web_base_url.description: Base URL of the web search API.

web_env_file.description: The env-file holding the web search key.

web_store.description: Directory of the full texts of truncated pages.

main_channel.description: The channel whose owner turns are top-level owner turns.

stall_guards.description: Switch of the identical-call notice and stub.

mcp_servers.description: Comma-separated names of the MCP servers, each configured under `engine.mcp.<name>`.

enabled.description: Switch of the early end of empty-reply retries.

no_ask_guard.description: The `no-ask-guard` policy, on when `route` is set.

note_file.description: The file of the continuation note.

instructions_file.description: The file of the classifier instructions.

log.description: The JSON-lines file of the guard's records.

route.description: Route alias of the summary turn.

protect_last_n.description: Recent messages a compaction keeps at least.

target_ratio.description: Share of the threshold kept as the verbatim tail, a decimal number.

threshold.description: Share of a route's window at which compaction runs, a decimal number.

threshold_tokens.description: Prompt tokens at which compaction runs at the latest; 0 sets no cap.

routes.description: One item section per route alias.

warnings_enabled.description: Switch of the warnings appended to tool results.

hard_stop_enabled.description: Switch of blocked calls and halted turns.

max_web_searches.description: `web_search` calls of one turn; 0 is no limit.

mcp.description: One item section per MCP server that `engine.mcp_servers` lists.

core.description: One item section per safeguard or meta-skill of the system prompt's core, by its id; the engine refuses an id it does not ship.

socket.description: The C4G socket of the gateway.

token_file.description: The file holding the bot token, mode 0600.

owner_ids.description: Owner user ids: an integer or comma-separated integers.

engine_connect_timeout.description: Seconds of a connect to the C6 socket.

engine_call_timeout.description: Seconds of a whole C6 call.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Bot API.

file_base_url.description: Base URL of Bot API file downloads.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds of a connect to the Bot API.

read_timeout.description: Seconds of a read from the Bot API.

write_timeout.description: Seconds of each write of a request body.

poll_timeout.description: Whole seconds of a long poll.

coalesce_quiet.description: Quiet window of the turn coalescer in seconds.

coalesce_max.description: Cap of a coalesced turn in seconds.

stt_env_file.description: The env-file holding the speech-to-text key; set, voice notes are transcribed.

stt_base_url.description: Base URL of the speech-to-text endpoint.

stt_echo_transcripts.description: Whether each voice transcript is echoed to the owner; default true.

reaction_wake_delay.description: Seconds from the first owner reaction to the wake-up turn.

reaction_context_header.description: First line of the reaction context.

guest_gate_url.description: The guest gate's endpoint the owner's protocol updates go to first (ADR-0083), such as `http://127.0.0.1:8792/internal/telegram`: plain HTTP only on a loopback host, else HTTPS. Unset, there is no gate. Needs `guest_gate_token_file`.

guest_gate_token_file.description: The file holding the guest gate's bearer token, mode 0600; read once at start. Needs `guest_gate_url`.

redact_secrets.description: Switch of the redaction of secrets in tool output; default on.

garden.description: The garden daemon, `ulei-garden serve`; it also reads `inbox.socket`.

store.description: The SQLite file of the store; `serve` requires it.

socket.description: The C7 socket, at most 107 bytes; `serve` requires it.

producer_key_file.description: The 32-byte C1 producer key the garden signs `garden_miss` with, owner-only; `serve` requires it.

domains_file.description: JSON of the starting domains, replacing the built-in list as the seed.

core_file.description: The rendered pinned core profile; unset, no render.

core_char_limit.description: Characters of the core profile; default 1375.

reranker.description: The reranker; only `none`, the default, is accepted.

second_level.description: The second-level provider of a miss; only `none`, the default, is accepted.

min_confidence.description: Least proposer confidence the edge accepts on its own, a decimal; default `"0.6"`.

reconcile_min_cosine.description: Least cosine at which a new fact and a current fact of the same entity are reconciled, a decimal; default `"0.85"`.

search_k.description: Facts of a `search` without `k`, 1 to 50; default 5.

pointer_min_cosine.description: Least cosine of a pointer, a decimal from 0 to 1; default `"0.3"`.

pointer_min_lexical.description: Least lexical score (-bm25) of a pointer, a decimal of 0 or more; default `"8.0"`.

enabled.description: Run the model in the helper; a helper that does not get ready stops the start, except one that refuses a corrupted weight file of the encoder engine or a store whose last check of that file failed, which start the daemon lexical-only with `dense` down until a check passes (ADR-0087 section 8); default false.

helper.description: The `ulei-garden-embed` binary; `serve` requires it when enabled.

model_dir.description: Directory of `onnx/model_quantized.onnx` and `tokenizer.json`; `serve` requires it when enabled.

ort_library.description: `libonnxruntime.so` of an official Linux x64 CPU release; `serve` requires it when enabled.

threads.description: Intra-op threads of the helper; default 2.

load_timeout.description: Seconds `serve` waits for the helper's ready line at start; default 120.

ttl.description: `[garden.ttl]`: lifetime of a fact per C7 `TtlKind`, seconds above 0 or `"never"`; `never_cache` has no key.

expire_interval.description: Least seconds between two expiry passes; default 60.

recheck_interval.description: Least seconds between two recheck batches; default 3600.

recheck_batch.description: Rechecks handed to the second level per batch; default 8.

maintain_interval.description: Seconds between two maintenance passes; default 604800.

verify_interval.description: Seconds between two content checks of the encoder engine's weight file by `ulei-garden-embed verify`, the first at start; default 86400. Only with the `native` backend (ADR-0087 section 8).

memory.description: The archive daemon, `ulei-memory serve`; it also reads `engine.c6_socket`, the C6 socket it pulls the dialogue from.

archive.description: The SQLite file of the archive; `serve` requires it.

socket.description: The C10 socket, at most 107 bytes; `serve` requires it.

connectors.description: The source connectors' runner, `ulei-connectors`; it also reads `memory.socket`, the C10 socket it puts items into. An item section `[connectors.<name>]` holds the owner's records for the connector of that C11 manifest name, which cannot be a key of this section.

dir.description: The connectors directory: one subdirectory per connector holding its C11 manifest `connector.json` and its program; may be a git work tree, in which the runner never runs git.

state.description: The runner's state and the connectors' data: `<state>/<name>/runner.json` holds the cursor, `<state>/<name>/data` is the connector's only writable directory.

log.description: The run log: one C11 `RunRecord` JSON line per run, mode 0600.

run_dir.description: The directory of the network brokers' sockets, one per run.

enabled.description: Comma-separated names of the connected connectors; the runner runs only these.

sync_every.description: Seconds between the runner's C10 `sync` calls; default 900.

hive_mcp.description: The hive's typed MCP server, `ulei-hive-mcp` (ADR-0071): the five C2 hive tools on a loopback address for the engine's `[engine.mcp.<name>]`; it runs each call as the hive's CLI.

listen.description: The TCP address it listens on, `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `[::1]:<port>`; required.

token_file.description: The file of the bearer token the engine sends, at least 32 visible ASCII characters, open to no group or other user; required.

hive_command.description: The argv of the hive's CLI, split on whitespace without quoting, its first word an absolute path, such as an interpreter and `hive-py/scripts/hive.py`; required.

hive_config.description: The hive's TOML config, absolute; the CLI gets it as `HIVE_CONFIG`; required.

actor.description: The hive actor of every call: `--created-by` of a card it creates, `--by` of a steer and a cancel; default `secretary`.

timeout.description: Seconds one CLI run may take before it is killed; default 120.

hold.description: Every card it creates is held (`--hold`) until the owner runs `hive.py release`; default false.

night.description: The night gardener, `ulei-engine night` (ADR-0078): it sorts the seedbed, the forget queue and the configured archive history into the garden through the extraction model; it also reads `qb.socket`, `garden.socket` and `memory.socket`.

route.description: The C4G route alias of every extraction call; default `small`, the cheap alias of the example.

state.description: The directory of the night's cursor `cursor.json` and its run reports `runs/<start>.jsonl`; `ULEI_NIGHT_STATE` wins over it, and the unit sets that to its `StateDirectory`; required.

max_usd.description: Most USD one run spends, a decimal, from the gateway's usage answers and the prices below; default `"1.0"`.

price_input.description: USD per million input tokens of `route`, neither read from nor written to the cache, a decimal; default `"1.0"`.

price_output.description: USD per million output tokens of `route`, a decimal; default `"5.0"`.

price_cache_read.description: USD per million input tokens read from the prompt cache, a decimal; default `"0.1"`.

price_cache_write.description: USD per million input tokens written to the prompt cache, a decimal; default `"1.25"`.

max_prompt_tokens.description: Most estimated input tokens of one extraction call, 1,000 to 100,000; default 60000.

max_tokens.description: Output tokens of one extraction call; default 8192.

timeout.description: Seconds one extraction call may take; default 600.

seed_batch.description: Seedbed records per extraction call, 1 to 100; default 20.

sources.description: Comma-separated archive sources whose history the night sorts into the garden, session by session, such as the engine's `dialogue` and imported ones; default none.

separator.description: The separator of a history entry's `external_id`: its session is the part before the last separator, and an id without it is the session's own row, left out; default `/`.

roles.description: Comma-separated `who` values of the history entries a transcript keeps; default `user,assistant`.

message_chars.description: Most characters of one history message in a transcript, 200 to 16,384; default 3000.

Route.description: `[engine.routes.<alias>]`: the window of one route alias.

max_tokens.description: Output tokens a step may take.

idempotent_no_progress.description: Identical results of one read-only call.

CoreItem.description: `[engine.core.<id>]`: one safeguard or meta-skill of the core.

file.description: The file whose stripped text replaces the shipped text.

enabled.description: Switch of the item; default on.

url.description: The `http://` URL of the server on a loopback host.

env_file.description: The env-file of the request headers.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds of the connect and the tool listing.

tools.description: `[engine.mcp.<name>.tools]`: which tools of the server are registered.

include.description: Comma-separated tool names or globs; unset, all.

Connector.description: `[connectors.<name>]`: the owner's records for one connector; every widening of its isolation is one of them, and each run record lists those in effect.

key_file.description: The env-file of the key the manifest's `key` names; the runner checks that it exists, never reads it and passes its path, and Landlock grants read on this file only.

allow.description: Comma-separated `host:port` entries the broker connects to beyond the manifest's `source.addresses`, loopback and private addresses included.

read.description: Comma-separated paths Landlock grants read on beyond the run's own.

write.description: Comma-separated paths Landlock grants read and write on beyond the data directory.

network.description: `direct`: the run may open its own `AF_INET` and `AF_INET6` sockets, not pinned to an address; from Landlock ABI 4 their connect ports are limited to the ports of `source.addresses` and `allow`. Unset, its connections come from the broker only. Only this key grants it, never a manifest or a default.

landlock.description: `off`: runs proceed without Landlock, with seccomp and the broker. Unset, a run on a kernel without Landlock ABI 3 is refused. Only this key grants it, never a manifest or a default.
